name: Mytherceria — 3 Advanced — Ascendant Mytherceria: The Grandest Trick

system.description: Spending ten Blood Traits and one or more Willpower Traits, win a Static Mental Challenge against 15 minus Morality Traits to briefly shed the Curse of Caine and revert to mortality, losing supernatural Traits and Blood Pool but regaining all of it the instant the power's duration expires; death while mortal in this state is final.
system.duration: One hour per Willpower Trait spent
